author: danceratopz
content:
🦓 New mainnet test release: `tests@v20.0.2` - https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests@v20.0.2

**Fusaka only; up to Osaka/BPO2!** This is a [`Z` patch bump](https://steel.ethereum.foundation/docs/execution-specs/running_tests/releases/#versioning-scheme): no consensus changes, one breaking fixture format change.

🚨 Breaking for [`consume-enginex`](https://steel.ethereum.foundation/docs/execution-specs/running_tests/running/#enginex) users ([#3390](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3390)): Please update framework & fixtures in unison.

🗑️ Removed:
- EIP-7610 create collision tests ([#3417](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3417)).

🆕 New:
- Dynamic-destination JUMP/JUMPI invalid-target ([#3153](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3153)), EIP-2681 max-nonce regression ([#3226](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3226)), and EIP-7702 coverage for precompile calls from delegated frames and authority storage surviving delegation clears ([#3420](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3420), [#3421](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3421)) <@425274498732916736>.
- Expanded create collision tests (~2,550 fixtures, [#3425](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3425)) <@755913785620824175>, <@508125616940515329>, <@547171287831805972>.

🔧 Changed:
- ~2,700 existing fixtures re-fund test accounts with balances capped below `2^128` wei ([#3227](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3227), [#3230](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3230)) <@427491045308235776>, and the modified withdrawal/consolidation contract tests now verify requests via the block header ([#3235](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3235)) <@774033563732541451>.

PTAL at the [v20.0.2 release notes](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests@v20.0.2). As always, please ping if there are issues!
